a.lede: Apple's latest iOS 27.3 developer beta introduces a limited face unlock feature for the iPhone Duo, alongside other improvements.
a.title: Apple adds ‘face unlock’ to the iPhone Duo, but it’s not Face ID

b.lede: Originally launching only with Touch ID, Apple’s folding phone now borrows a feature from the new HomeView and can recognize your mug, but it’s likely not as secure as Face ID.
b.title: The iPhone Duo Is Getting a Limited Version of Face ID
